advisor.title: AI study advisor
advisor.lead: Ask about programs, requirements, scholarships and costs. Answers come only from GEC’s database.
advisor.hello: Hi! Tell me what you would like to study, where, your English score and budget — for example:
advisor.example1: Master’s in Data Science in the UK, IELTS 6.5, budget $20,000
advisor.example2: Which scholarships are there for a bachelor’s in the USA?
advisor.example3: How much does a year in Canada cost?
advisor.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
advisor.search_mode: The AI assistant is not connected yet, so you get a direct search of GEC’s database instead of a written answer.
advisor.search_intro: Programs in GEC’s database that fit your question ({n} found):
advisor.over_budget: None of these are within your budget — these are the closest. A counsellor can suggest scholarships or other options.
advisor.none: Nothing in our database matches yet. A counsellor can look further for you.
advisor.ai_error: The AI service did not answer, so here is a direct database search.
advisor.disclaimer: Guidance from GEC’s database, not an admission decision. Check details on the university’s official page or with a counsellor.
advisor.no_js: The advisor needs JavaScript. You can still search programs in the

ai.how_it_works: The advisor answers only from GEC’s database through read-only tools (programs, scholarships, costs, requirements). It is told never to invent programs or promise admission. Without a key it runs a plain database search and says so.
ai.model_hint: claude-opus-5-5 gives the best answers; smaller models are faster and cheaper.
ai.test_help: Ask a test question to check the connection.
ai.test_search: The AI is not connected; the advisor runs in search mode.
ai.usage: {n} questions in 30 days ({ai} answered by AI)
ai.log_note: Questions are kept to improve answers and for audit; they are visible to administrators only.
